card.name: Dosage form or route word after drug
card.fires_on: The word that completes a dosage form or route of administration right after a drug name, such as Tablets, capsules, nasal spray, intravenously, subcutaneous or sublingual. It appears mostly in dosing and switching sections.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: Form word such as Tablets, ules or spray following a drug name when converting between products.
modes.example: Guidelines for Initial Conversion from Carbidopa and Levodopa Immediate-release<< Tablets>> to Carbidopa and Levodopa

modes.label: Route word being completed
modes.description: The end of a route word like intravenously, subcutaneous or sublingual, or a route abbreviation like PO.
modes.example: Administer immunotherapy by subcut<<aneous>> injection in the lateral aspect of the arm
